simple.meaning: עַשְׁתֵּי (ʻashtêy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “eleven or (ordinal) eleventh.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 26:7. The surrounding context includes family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַשְׁתֵּי (H6249) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עַשְׁתֵּי (ʻashtêy) / H6249 is traced through Exodus 26:7, Exodus 26:8, Exodus 36:14, Exodus 36:15 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H6249. ashte עַשְׁתֵּי 19 noun number one (Assyrian išten , one ; išten ešrit , eleven ; Dl § 75, Tel Amarna [iš-]tit , first time ; see Gie ZAW i (1881), 226 Ges § 97e Kö ii. l, 212 and references ); — only + עֶשְׂרֵה עָשָׂר, (q. v.) = eleven, eleventh , Jer 1:3 ; 39:2 = 52:5 = 2Kin 25:2 ; Ezek 26:1 40:49 ; Zech 1:7 ; Exod 26:7-8 , 36:14-15 , Num 7:72 ; 29:20 (all P), Deut 1:3 ; 1Chr 12:13 ; 24:12 ; 25:18 ; 27:14 .
definitions.rootNote: apparently masculine plural construction of 6247 in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with 6240 in lieu of 259 )
